Catalan

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Latin commentārī.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): (Central) [ku.mənˈta]
  • IPA(key): (Balearic) [ko.mənˈta]
  • IPA(key): (Valencia) [ko.menˈtaɾ]
  • Rhymes: -a(ɾ)

Verb

[edit]

comentar (first-person singular present comento, first-person singular preterite comentí, past participle comentat); root stress: (Central, Valencia, Balearic) /e/

  1. to comment

Portuguese

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Latin commentārī.

Pronunciation

[edit]
 
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /ko.mẽˈta(ʁ)/ [ko.mẽˈta(h)]
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /ko.mẽˈta(ʁ)/ [ko.mẽˈta(h)]
    • (São Paulo) IPA(key): /ko.mẽˈta(ɾ)/
    • (Rio de Janeiro) IPA(key): /ko.mẽˈta(ʁ)/ [ko.mẽˈta(χ)]
    • (Caipira) IPA(key): /ko.mẽˈta(ɻ)/
 
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /ku.mẽˈtaɾ/
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /ku.mẽˈtaɾ/
    • (Southern Portugal) IPA(key): /ku.mẽˈta.ɾi/

Verb

[edit]

comentar (first-person singular present comento, first-person singular preterite comentei, past participle comentado)

  1. to comment (make a comment)

Spanish

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From Latin commentārī.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /komenˈtaɾ/ [ko.mẽn̪ˈt̪aɾ]
  • Rhymes: -aɾ
  • Syllabification: co‧men‧tar

Verb

[edit]

comentar (first-person singular present comento, first-person singular preterite comenté, past participle comentado)

  1. to comment (make a comment)

Usage notes

[edit]
  • This verb can be used transitively for more formal effect.
comentar (sobre) un tema ― Comment on a theme
